semanticAnalysis.sprintSummary: This sprint appears to have two distinct goals. The first is building out an application feature for reviewing and approving proposals and other content. The second is a mix of enhancing an automated content generation workflow and producing a marketing or demonstration video about a separate automation.

unclearWork.title: Setup Worksheet Connectivity
unclearWork.problem: This task is too vague. It doesn't specify which worksheet, what technology (e.g., Google Sheets API, Excel library), the purpose of the connection (read/write), or which feature it supports. It is not actionable as written.

strengths: The breakdown of the proposal feature into separate front-end screens (#2185, #2186) and back-end functionality (#2187) is a good separation of concerns.
The content workflow tasks (#2202, #2203, #2204) represent a clear, logical progression for building a single, larger feature, showing good incremental planning for that specific feature.
